subject.title: improve: stream native sessions as hosts finish

question: Should OpenClaw make `onHost` a supported public session-catalog provider callback and retain `sessions.catalog.host` as the additive progressive Gateway contract?
rationale: The branch changes the durable plugin SDK and Gateway protocol surface; tests can show behavior, but they cannot choose the permanent extension contract or its ownership boundary.

options.title: Accept the additive contract
options.body: Approve the callback and host event as the supported progressive-catalog extension path while preserving the aggregate response as authoritative.

options.title: Keep progress internal
options.body: Avoid exposing `onHost` through the provider API and pursue progressive updates through an internal core-owned mechanism instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive contract
recommendation.body: Approve the callback and host event as the supported progressive-catalog extension path while preserving the aggregate response as authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch evidence places this person closest to the proposed cross-surface session-catalog design.
